source.citation: Hillenbrand, J., Getty, L. A., Clark, M. J., & Wheeler, K. (1995). Acoustic characteristics of American English vowels. JASA 97(5), 3099-3111.
source.note: Derived statistics only; the per-token data is not redistributed.

method.groups: Adult men and women; children excluded.
method.measures: Steady-state values (vowdata.dat columns 3-7). Zeros (not measurable) are excluded per measure, so n varies.
method.log: log_* fields use natural log of Hz.
method.f0_speaker_median_hz: Median F0 across each speaker's vowels, then summarised across speakers.
method.delta_f_hz: Zero-intercept regression of F1-F4 on (2i-1)/2 per token, averaged per speaker (speakers with >=6 complete tokens), then summarised across speakers.
method.f1_f2: Token-level F1/F2 means and sample covariance, for ellipses.
